content:
Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. is a dynamic and innovative chemical company located at No. 136, Qingchun Road, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, China. Positioned in one of the most economically vibrant and industrially advanced regions of China, the company benefits from a strategic location that facilitates access to both domestic and international markets. Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, and distribution of high-quality chemical materials, catering to diverse industries such as pharmaceuticals, agriculture, coatings, electronics, and advanced manufacturing.

Committed to innovation and sustainability, Zhejiang Runhe leverages state-of-the-art technology and stringent quality control measures to ensure that its products meet the highest industry standards. The company’s dedicated research and development team continuously explores new chemical formulations and materials that enhance performance, reduce environmental impact, and meet evolving market demands. By fostering strong partnerships with clients and suppliers, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. emphasizes customer satisfaction and tailor-made solutions.

In addition to product excellence, the company prioritizes safety, environmental responsibility, and operational efficiency. Its modern facilities are designed to comply with international safety and environmental regulations, reflecting a corporate philosophy that values long-term growth alongside ecological stewardship. With a commitment to innovation, quality, and sustainable development, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. stands as a prominent player in China’s chemical industry, contributing to advances in material sciences and supporting the growth of various industrial sectors.
